column1: # The v0.8.0 release notes' ERROR claims: the cells whose "now" column says the
# program stops instead of answering. One per line:
# Tab-separated, `#` comments ignored. Each program must exit NON-ZERO and its
# stderr must contain the substring. Both halves matter: an exit code without the
# message is a program that failed for some other reason.
# Every path below is one the CLAIMS PROGRAM created, so these run after it and depend on
# nothing about the host. `/etc/hostname` would not exist everywhere these are run.
# --- the storage substrate refuses rather than guessing ---
# --- `read_at` must refuse bytes that are not text; that refusal is why Bytes exists ---
# --- Bytes: the conversions that can fail say so instead of substituting ---
# --- the row window: a negative offset is `tail`'s question, not a clamp ---
# --- a column name is a string; `1` and "1" must not merge into one column ---
# --- html_escape refuses a non-string rather than stringifying it ---
